title: Maple and Waffle's Strawberry Secret
markdown:
It was a warm sunny day in the garden. Busy bees were buzzing, flying from flower to flower. Maple the guinea pig, with her soft mossy fur and a happy tummy, was nibbling a big juicy dandelion. Her little nose wiggled with every bite. Beside her, Waffle the rabbit, with twitchy whiskers and long floppy ears, was practicing little hops. His fluffy tail gave a happy bounce with each hop. Their garden was full of fun things.

“Maple,” said Waffle, his nose wiggling. “What’s behind those tall green bean plants? They look like a secret.”

Maple stopped nibbling. A little bit of dandelion fluff was on her chin. Her nose twitched. “I don’t know, Waffle,” she squeaked. “But it looks like a good place to find more yummy dandelions.”

Maple wiggled her round body. Waffle gave a happy hop. They padded softly towards the bean plants. The plants were so tall. Their leafy branches made a shady tunnel. Maple and Waffle squeezed through, noses first, then tummies, then tails. The big green leaves tickled their noses. The air smelled like warm earth and fresh leaves. It was quiet and peaceful back there, a little green room the sun had almost forgotten.

Then they saw it. Peeking from under the leaves was something bright red. They were round and plump, like little red jewels. They smelled so sweet, like a summer day. It made their noses wiggle even more.

“Strawberries,” whispered Waffle. His eyes were wide. He had never seen so many.

Maple waddled closer. Her tummy gave a happy gurgle. “Oh, Waffle,” she breathed. “They look so yummy. I bet they taste like happy sunshine.”

They each chose a perfect juicy strawberry. Maple picked a plump one. Waffle found one for his little paws. Munch, munch, munch. The strawberries were sweet and soft. They tasted like sunshine and happiness. Maple squeaked with delight. Waffle gave a happy thump with his foot.

They sat side by side. The sun dappled through the leaves. They shared their yummy secret treat. They didn’t need many words. Just happy munching sounds and contented sighs. Noses wiggled. Sweet juice shone on their whiskers. One more strawberry waited between them, and they split it, nibble for nibble.

The sun began to dip low. The clouds turned soft orange and gentle pink. Maple and Waffle snuggled together. Their tummies were full of sweet strawberries. Their hearts were full of happy discovery. They had found a secret patch of sweetness, and they had shared it. Behind the bean plants the red jewels waited for another day, and two small friends rested in the warm shade, dreaming of sunny gardens and sweet sweet strawberries.
